content.short: Rotki is an open-source portfolio tracker, accounting, and analytics tool that protects your privacy.
content.description: Rotki is an open-source portfolio tracker, accounting, and analytics tool designed with privacy in mind. It helps you own your financial data and keep it secure by storing it encrypted locally on your computer, so sensitive information stays under your control. By combining portfolio tracking with accounting and analytics, Rotki provides a comprehensive view of your finances while preserving user privacy and data sovereignty.
